plan.title: Short Blue Clip Kept Intact
plan.summary: Kept the full 3-second source intact as a single segment because the visible footage shows only a consistent dark blue screen.

segments.label: Solid dark blue frame
segments.reason: Visible evidence is a uniform dark navy blue field with no objects, people, movement, or text; keeping the full range preserves the short clip intact.

analysis_notes: Meta director selected the moments; scene cuts, speech bands and transcript come from local analysis.
warnings: Transcript unavailable (whisper-cli did not write an SRT.); moments use scene cuts and speech energy.
Transcript unavailable (whisper-cli did not write an SRT.); moments use scene cuts and speech energy.
The source is 640x360, so this 1920x1080 export is upscaled and gains no detail.

review.verdict: This 3.0s cut works: the steady dark blue screen with centered white Pause in Blue text from 0.0 to 3.0s is simple, legible and calm. Keep as is.
review.caption_suggestion: Pause in Blue — a quiet 3-second breath on deep blue.
strengths: Solid dark blue screen from 0.0 to 3.0s holds steady and calming with no distraction.
Centered white Pause in Blue text at 1.2s reads instantly against the dark blue.
Three-second duration lets the blue field and title breathe as one quiet idea.
